title: Unchecked Dependency Option Combinatorics
damaged_code:
```toml
# Cargo.toml - No verification of flag compatibility
[features]
feature_a = []
feature_b = []
```
pattern: Defining multiple optional build flags or package features without validating that compilation succeeds under all combinations of those options.
why_bad: Downstream users enabling specific combinations of flags will run into compilation errors because the developer only tested the defaults or a fully enabled state.
detection: A package with multiple optional features lacking multi-configuration compilation sweeps (e.g., `cargo-hack` loops) in its continuous integration script.
counterexample:
```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci.yml
- name: Test all feature combinations
  run: cargo hack test --feature-powerset
```
fix: Configure the project's CI pipeline to systematically build and test the codebase under the entire power-set of defined features.
source: Jon Gjengset - *Rust For Rustaceans_ Idiomatic Programming for Experienced Developers* (2021, No Starch Press).pdf, Chapter 6.
